WITH invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT
    i.invoice_number,
    AVG(ili.product_price) AS mean_line_item_price,
    COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoices AS i
  LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
    ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  GROUP BY i.invoice_number
)
SELECT
  (SELECT AVG(mean_line_item_price)
   FROM invoice_stats
   WHERE mean_line_item_price IS NOT NULL) AS average_invoice_mean_line_item_price,
  (SELECT AVG(line_item_count)
   FROM invoice_stats) AS average_line_items_per_invoice;

assumptions.assumption: Each row in Invoice_Line_Items represents one line item; invoices with no line items count as zero line items for the second average. Invoices without any non-missing product_price are excluded from the first average as requested.
